concerns.text: The plan applies bias‑correction factors (derived from a held‑out 10 % subset) to the raw vulnerability counts **before** performing McNemar’s paired test (steps 2.2‑2.4). McNemar’s test assumes raw paired binary outcomes; weighting or adjusting the counts breaks the test’s distributional assumptions and can lead to invalid p‑values. Either (a) perform McNemar on the unadjusted paired flags and report bias‑corrected effect sizes separately, or (b) use a statistical method that accommodates weighted paired data (e.g., generalized estimating equations).
